name: Tyler Ritchie
title: Principal & Operations
bio:
Tyler joined The Ritchie Group in 2018 as a Project Manager. Prior to returning to Salt Lake City, Tyler spent 13 years with a Las Vegas title company overseeing title and escrow operations, and helped the company grow from the ground up to become a top 5 title company in Nevada. Currently, Tyler oversees the daily operations of The Ritchie Group including securities compliance, transaction closing, investor relations, and information technology.

Tyler graduated from Brigham Young University with a Bachelor’s degree in Human biology. When not in the office, Tyler enjoys time with his family, catching up on technology trends, playing the piano, and tackling a home improvement project with his wife.
